Rental period: OCTOBER TO 31 2027

Apt Grace Your Winter Escape in the Algarve
Enjoy the best of southern Portugal at Apt Grace, a modern and comfortable two-bedroom apartment in a quiet residential setting, just 2.5 km from the historic centre of Tavira and 3 km from the beautiful beaches of Cabanas.
With its sunny balcony, fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning throughout and access to a shared outdoor pool and tennis courts, Apt Grace is an ideal home away from home whether you are looking for a relaxing winter retreat, a longer stay in the Algarve, or the perfect base for exploring the region and enjoying its excellent golf courses.
Comfort & Facilities
 2 comfortable bedrooms
 1 bathroom
 Fully equipped kitchen
 Bright open-plan living and dining area
 Comfortable sofa and TV with MEO channels
 Dining table
 Air conditioning throughout the apartment
 Free WiFi
 Sunny private balcony with outdoor table and chairs
 Shared outdoor swimming pool with pool bar
 Fenced pool area for added safety
 On-site tennis courts
A Perfect Winter Escape
Escape the cold and dark winter months in Northern Europe and enjoy the mild climate, sunshine and relaxed lifestyle of the Algarve.
Apt Grace is particularly well suited for those looking to spend the winter in a warmer climate, with plenty of opportunities for outdoor living, walking, cycling, sightseeing and, of course, golf.
With several excellent golf courses within easy reach, the apartment makes an ideal base for golf enthusiasts. Whether you are looking for a peaceful winter home, a comfortable temporary residence, or simply a sunny escape from the northern winter, Apt Grace offers the perfect setting to enjoy the milder side of Europe.
Location
Apt Grace is ideally located for enjoying both the charm of Tavira and the natural beauty of the eastern Algarve.
 Tavira historic centre: 2.5 km
 Cabanas Beach: 3 km
 Benamor Golf: 3.1 km
 Quinta da Ria Golf: 6.8 km
 Quinta de Cima Golf: 7.8 km
 Ria Formosa Natural Park: nearby
 Faro International Airport: 48 km
The nearby Ria Formosa Natural Park offers a spectacular landscape of lagoons, islands, sandy beaches and walking trails, while Tavira provides a wonderful choice of restaurants, cafés, local markets and shops.
Your Home in the Algarve
Located in a peaceful and family-friendly residential area, Apt Grace combines comfort, sunshine and convenience. Local shops, markets and restaurants are easily accessible, while Tavira, Cabanas and the surrounding beaches are just a short drive away.
Whether you come to escape the northern winter, enjoy the Algarve’s exceptional golf courses, explore the Ria Formosa, or simply slow down and enjoy life in the sunshine, Apt Grace is a welcoming place to call home for your stay in southern Portugal.
Rental period: OCTOBER TO 31 2027 
Water and electricity are included in the monthly rent.
A 500 security deposit is required and must be paid by bank transfer prior to check-in. The deposit will be refunded after check-out, once the apartment has been inspected and confirmed to be in good condition.
